description: This line plot illustrates the 'Harmful with Refusal Ratio' as a function of sample size for four distinct model-benchmark combinations. The x-axis represents sample size, presented on a linear scale with tick marks at 128, 256, 512, and 1024, with no explicit unit label. The y-axis represents the 'Harmful with Refusal Ratio,' also on a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 0.5 in increments of 0.1. The blue line, corresponding to 'LlaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep,' begins at approximately 0.2 at a sample size of 128, increases steadily to about 0.4 at 512, and remains constant through 1024. The orange line, 'Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep,' starts at around 0.15 at 128, rises sharply to approximately 0.45 at 512, and stabilizes at that level through 1024. The green line, 'LlaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench,' begins at approximately 0.08 at 128, rises to nearly 0.4 by 512, and remains constant thereafter. The red line, 'Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench,' starts at 0.25 at 128, reaches approximately 0.45 at 512, and slightly increases to 0.5 at 1024. A legend in the bottom right corner maps each line's color and marker to its respective model and benchmark.
